title: Anti-fascist gathering outside Athens appellate court on Golden Dawn verdict day
participants_original: Guardian reports tens of thousands; ERT reports above 20,000; Athens 9.84 reports about 15,000. Estimates are kept separate.
threshold_50_evidence: Three contemporaneous accounts independently place the crowd far above 50; other city counts are not assigned to Athens.

participants.summary: Estimates differ but all exceed 50; no synthesized count.

demand.summary: Gathered around verdict and celebrated ruling; demand/target classification open.

state_response.summary: Some crowd dispersal measures after subgroup clashes; no transfer to whole crowd.

notes: Domestic court verdict is the focus; whether this satisfies state-demand criterion and exact event boundary await independent review.
open_questions: Independent reviewer to assess eligibility and final coding.
Official baseline and completeness remain pending.
